purpose: Place an action before another event.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Dictionary-form verb + 前に; noun + の前に.
I read before going to bed.
I checked the documents before the meeting.
Please close the windows before going out.
formation: Dictionary-form verb + 前に; noun + の前に.
restrictions: The verb before 前に stays in dictionary form even in a past account.
mistake: Use 食べる前に, not 食べた前に.
